title: Mary B Probable NDE 22643
content: I was sitting down, leaning over, with my arms on the table and my head resting in my arms. Suddenly I could see my upper body rise and sit upright. It was dark, and very still, with nothing around me except my deceased mother, on the other side of an invincible fence. She couldn't find my deceased brother and was waiting for me to go to her side of the fence so we can look for him together. Then I was awaken by the banging on my door and taken to the hospital.

elements.At the time of your experience, was ther: Yes drinking and pills Accidental overdose.
elements.The experience included: Out of body experience | Presence of deceased persons | Darkness | Boundary
elements.Did you feel separated from your body?: Yes My upper half lifted out of my body.
elements.Did time seem to speed up or slow down?: Everything seemed to be happening at once; or time stopped or lost all meaning
elements.Did you encounter or become aware of any: Yes My deceased mother on the other side of an invisible fence. There was no communication.
elements.Did scenes from your past come back to y: My past flashed before me, out of my control
elements.Did you come to a border or point of no: I came to a barrier that I was not permitted to cross; or was sent back against my will I was awoken by the banging on my door.
elements.God, Spiritual and Religion: point of no return? I came to a barrier that I was not permitted to cross; or was sent back against my will I was awoken by the banging on my door. God, Spiritual and Religion
elements.Concerning our Earthly lives other than: because of your experience? No Concerning our Earthly lives other than Religion: After the NDE
elements.After the NDE: change in your values and beliefs because of your experience? No Concerning our Earthly lives other than Religion: After the NDE
elements.Do you have any psychic, non-ordinary or: Yes I've always had paranormal/special gifts, before and after the experience.
